mapper.sql: select id, user_id, memory_type, content, keywords, vector_id, confidence, source_record_id, hit_count, last_hit_time, create_time, update_time from ai_user_memory
mapper.insert: insert ignore into ai_user_memory (user_id, memory_type, content, keywords, vector_id, confidence, source_record_id) values (#{userId}, #{memoryType}, #{content}, #{keywords}, #{vectorId}, #{confidence}, #{sourceRecordId})
mapper.update: update ai_user_memory set hit_count = hit_count + 1, last_hit_time = now() where id in #{id}

insert into ai_user_profile (user_id, total_questions, total_sessions, last_active_time) values (#{userId}, 1, 1, now()) on duplicate key update total_questions = total_questions + 1, last_active_time = now()
mapper.select: select id, user_id, tags, preferred_categories, preferred_books, total_questions, total_sessions, last_active_time, profile_summary, create_time, update_time from ai_user_profile where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into ai_user_profile (user_id, tags, preferred_categories, preferred_books, total_questions, total_sessions, last_active_time, profile_summary) values (#{userId}, #{tags}, #{preferredCategories}, #{preferredBooks}, #{totalQuestions}, #{totalSessions}, #{lastActiveTime}, #{profileSummary})
